portfolio.title: Honorato Barber Shop & Grooming Lounge
portfolio.shortDescription: Official high-converting digital presence and online booking experience with modern dark aesthetic and mobile-first scheduling.
portfolio.fullDescription: Custom high-performance web experience engineered for Honorato Barber Shop (live at honoratobarbershop.com.br). Features automated appointment scheduling, service packages showcase, team barber portfolios, and direct WhatsApp VIP booking integration.

portfolio.title: Sofisticasa Interior & Architecture Studio
portfolio.shortDescription: Editorial-grade portfolio experience highlighting luxury residential projects, material finishes, and consultation scheduling.
portfolio.fullDescription: Sophisticated digital showcase for an upscale interior architecture studio. Focuses on immersive project galleries, client brief intake forms, and seamless responsive typography that elevates brand credibility.

portfolio.title: Apex Auto Detailing & Ceramic Studio
portfolio.shortDescription: Interactive vehicle package selector with dynamic quote calculation and high-resolution before/after comparisons.
portfolio.fullDescription: Custom automotive studio web application featuring interactive service tier selection (Paint Correction, Ceramic Coating, PPF), quote estimator, and localized Google Maps & review integration.

portfolio.title: RydenFlow Business Operations ERP
portfolio.shortDescription: Modular internal enterprise dashboard for job tracking, real-time invoicing, customer management, and team dispatch.
portfolio.fullDescription: Enterprise workflow management system built to replace scattered spreadsheets. Centralizes quotes, automated payment status tracking, inventory alerts, and role-based staff permissions into one fast, secure cloud portal.

portfolio.title: Ótica Central Precision Eyewear
portfolio.shortDescription: Modern digital catalog and prescription appointment scheduling system for boutique optical practices.
portfolio.fullDescription: Digital catalog and examination scheduling web app. Allows patients to browse curated designer frames, upload prescription documents securely, and book comprehensive optometry examinations in seconds.

portfolio.title: AutoAssist AI Customer Dispatcher
portfolio.shortDescription: Intelligent multi-channel intake bot that pre-qualifies incoming inquiries and syncs directly into CRM calendars.
portfolio.fullDescription: Automated conversational pipeline connecting WhatsApp, web contact forms, and Google Calendar. Automatically answers frequent service questions, estimates turnaround times, and books consultations without manual staff overhead.
